text:
alex: FYI started a staggered OOB BMC firmware push in ap-se2 ~03:00Z. A few racks flipped secure-boot back on unexpectedly, some nodes failed provisioning into GPU pool.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled by release-engineering at 2026-03-19T03:00Z, batch: 7 racks.
maria: seeing lots of `ipmi: connection reset` on jump hosts, jump1 -> jump3 have transient SSH flakes. Autoscaler already draining 12 GPUs.
sam: do we have the ipmitool logs? paste the last failed IPMI session please.
alex: here —
```
# ipmitool -H bmc-rack-07 -U admin -P **** sol info
Error: Connection reset by peer
# journalctl -u oob-agent -n 80 | grep -i ipmi
Mar 19 03:02:14 oob-agent[1420]: ipmi: session reset by remote (errno 104)
Mar 19 03:02:17 oob-agent[1420]: bmc: secureboot flag toggled -> true (unexpected)
Mar 19 03:02:19 oob-agent[1420]: initiating host reboot due to uefi-change
```
maria: thanks. looks like the firmware applied a NVMe/PCIe hotplug microfix that also toggles UEFI lockdown when a certain TPM descriptor is present. We've seen this vendor quirk once in staging.
jin: if hosts reboot with secure-boot on and keys not present, PXE will fail and provisioner will drop them from gpu-pool. That's why autoscaler is pulling from ondemand in us-west2. Cost spike alert firing.
sam: opened a quick mitigation patch: forced BMC keepalive interval increase + blocking the secure-boot attr via ipmitool (temporary). Runbook step -> `ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin raw 0x30 0x45 0x01 0x00` (DO NOT run cluster-wide).
alex: @maria can you run the block on the three affected racks (07/08/09) and taint them for controlled reprovision?
maria: doing rack-07 now, starting commands. will patch jump hosts first.
ops-bot: incident-cost-alert: estimated 4.6k USD/hr due to cross-region fallback.
jin: reminder — check KMS rotations: if secure-boot flips we need to ensure key blobs are present on hosts or they'll stay non-bootable. Contacted infra-security to fetch key parity.
sam: quick note for postmortem: vendor FW 2.4.7-rc includes TPM descriptor change; recommend blocking auto-toggle or vendor patch.
alex: rolling pause on remaining batches. pausing at batch 2. coordinating with release-eng on a targeted rollback or vendor hotfix.
oncall-bot: oncall ping to @maria @alex @sam for 30m follow-up.
alex: thanks team — will update in 15 with progress.
